title: Investigate file tools disabled mid-session in worker sessions
what: Three worker sessions in a row reported that Read, Grep and the other file tools returned "disabled for this session": #828 (iteration 0192), #831 (0193) and #834 (0194, blocked, nothing saved, 8 turns). Earlier: 0-turn sessions #794 and #813, interruptions #788, #800 and 0190. Evidence: .session/reports/834.json, record .session/history/records/0194.json (#834 status blocked, artifacts 0).
why: The positive-control step 4 work has been ordered twice and cannot run while tools are disabled; no_progress is 3. The cause appears to be in the session or engine setup, which the execution layer cannot see or change.
unblocks: Step 4 of the positive-control thread (#763 f4) and every later benchmark task.
